concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-managing-terminals-board-terminal]] — Adyen physical terminal boarding guide captured 2026-09-15 for assignment-before-boarding, manual versus eligible OTP flow, payment-method/software/role gates and old-store reassignment risk.
warnings: OTP boarding applies only to enabled integrated terminals on software 1.94 or later; standalone boarding is manual.

The source's general up-to-30-minute boarding duration and up-to-three-hour WebSockets-disabled reassignment duration cover different conditions; no assignment response proves physical readiness or payment execution.
